terms.note: A user's (or TIDAL's) ordered list of tracks.
A music release.
One song or piece in an album or playlist.
A performer; also the artist's page.
A TIDAL-generated personal playlist (My Mix, Daily Discovery). Not the act of mixing audio.
An endless station of similar tracks, started from a track or artist.
The list of tracks that will play next.
"My Collection": the user's saved playlists, albums, tracks and artists.
Items the user marked with the heart.
TIDAL's list of items saved to play later.

terms.note: The full-screen view of the current track.
Fading one track into the next.
The 10-band audio EQ.
The browse and search page.
New releases from followed artists.
Song text, often synced to playback.
Who wrote, produced and performed a track.
A user's TIDAL profile page.
Keeps playing similar tracks when the queue ends.
The audio reaches the device unchanged (exclusive output, no DSP).
Output that takes the audio device for this app alone.

styles.cs: Formal vykání (lowercase vy/váš), sentence case, Czech quotes „…“, space before % and units (100 %), en dash – in prose; inserted names kept in nominative via colon or apposition (Přehrát: {title}, interpretem {name}).
styles.da: Uformel du-form som i TIDAL/Spotify på dansk; knapper i bydeform (Afspil, Gem), sætningsstart med stort kun på første ord; anførselstegn ”…”; typografisk apostrof ’; tankestreg – med mellemrum; mellemrum før % (100 %); tastnavne som på danske tastaturer (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Pil op).
styles.de: Informal du (like TIDAL/Spotify German), imperatives in du-form; German quotation marks „…“; en dash with spaces for em dashes; space before % (100 %); key names as Windows shows them (Strg, Umschalt, Entf, Rücktaste); Track = Titel, Artist = Künstler, Queue = Warteschlange.
styles.el: Informal singular address (εσύ), as in Greek Spotify; monotonic accents; labels and buttons use nouns (Αναπαραγωγή, Προσθήκη στην ουρά), help text uses imperatives (Πάτησε, Σύρε); « » quotes; inserted names stay in the nominative, placed after a noun (στη λίστα «{playlist}») or a colon (Αναπαραγωγή: {title}); question mark is ; ;brand/tier names and Mix, Crossfade, streaming, scrobbling stay in Latin script.
styles.es: Neutral Spanish, informal tú (as TIDAL/Spotify); sentence case; “curly” quotes; space before % (100 %); plurals one/many/other with “# de …” for many; Playlist and Mix kept as loanwords; móvil for phone.
styles.fi: Informal sinä address (as in Spotify/TIDAL Finnish); sentence case; ”…” quotation marks; en dash with spaces; space before % and units; inserted names kept uninflected via a preceding noun or a colon (”soittolistaan {playlist}”, ”Toista: {title}”); Finnish key names Vaihto, Askelpalautin, arrow names; Ctrl/Alt/Esc kept.
styles.fr: Vouvoiement (as in TIDAL’s French apps); sentence case; « » with U+202F inside, U+202F before ; : ! ? and %; ’ apostrophe; infinitive or imperative for actions; plural categories one/many/other (many = « # de … »).
styles.hu: Informal address (te), as in TIDAL/Spotify Hungarian; sentence case; „…” quotation marks; en dash with spaces for asides; inserted names never take suffixes ("Hozzáadva ehhez: {playlist}", "Lejátszás: {title}"); plurals use one/other with the singular noun after numbers.
styles.id: Bahasa Indonesia, informal-sopan: sapaan "kamu/-mu" (seperti Spotify), kalimat kapital biasa, tanda kutip “…”, desimal koma (44,1 kHz); istilah teknis musik (playlist, mix, crossfade, equalizer, bit-perfect) dipakai apa adanya.
styles.it: Informal “tu”, sentence case, imperative verbs for actions; «…» quotation marks; typographic apostrophe ’; “In riproduzione”, “Coda”, “Salva per dopo”, “La mia collezione” used everywhere.
styles.ja: です/ます調（敬語は控えめ）、ラベル・ボタンは名詞または動詞の終止形で簡潔に。和文では全角の読点・句点・括弧・コロン（、。「」（）：）、ICU構文はASCIIのまま。和文中にスペースを入れない。Ctrl/Alt/Shiftなどのキー名はそのまま。複数形はotherのみ。
styles.ko: 합니다체(존댓말) 문장과 간결한 명사형 라벨; 대기열·플레이리스트·곡·즐겨찾기·나중에 듣기·내 컬렉션 용어 통일; {name} 뒤에는 조사를 붙이지 않고 콜론이나 명사로 연결; 청소년 유해 배지는 19; 따옴표는 “ ”.
styles.nb: Bokmål, uformell «du»-form, setningsstil på store bokstaver, «» som anførselstegn, tankestrek (–) med mellomrom, mellomrom før % og desimalkomma; tastenavn som Ctrl/Alt/Shift beholdes, piltaster skrives «pil opp/ned».
styles.nl: Informeel 'je/jouw' zoals TIDAL en Spotify in het Nederlands; zinshoofdletter; labels als infinitief (‘Wachtrij wissen’); enkele typografische aanhalingstekens ‘…’ en ’ als apostrof; Ctrl/Alt/Shift blijven, pijltoetsen als ‘pijl-omhoog’; ‘Kan … niet …’ voor foutmeldingen.
styles.pl: Informal second person (ty) with Twój/Ciebie capitalized as in TIDAL/Spotify PL; sentence case; „…” quotes; inserted names kept in the nominative via "Label: {name}" phrasing; imperative verbs on buttons, past-tense impersonal (Dodano/Usunięto) in notifications.
styles.pt-BR: Português do Brasil, tratamento informal por “você” (como Spotify e TIDAL no Brasil), caixa de frase, aspas curvas “ ”, reticências …, vírgula decimal (44,1 kHz); termos técnicos de áudio e “playlist”, “mix”, “scrobble”, “crossfade” mantidos em inglês como no uso brasileiro.
styles.ro: Informal „tu” (imperative 2nd singular for actions, e.g. „Redă”, „Adaugă”), sentence case, „…” quotes, comma-below ș ț, Romanian plurals one/few/other with „de” in other (# de piese), progress states as „Se încarcă…”, decimal comma (44,1 kHz).
styles.ru: Formal «вы» (lowercase), sentence case, « » quotes, imperative-infinitive buttons («Добавить в очередь»); inserted names kept in the nominative via colons/appositions; units and brand/tier names (kHz, Hz, dB, BPM, Max, High, Low) kept as in English; Ctrl/Alt/Shift kept, arrows spelled «Стрелка вверх».
styles.sv: Informellt du-tilltal som i TIDAL/Spotify på svenska; sentence case, svenska citattecken ”…”, tankstreck –, mellanslag före % och enheter, imperativ på knappar (Spela upp, Lägg till), ”Det gick inte att …” för fel.
styles.tr: Informal “sen” address with imperative verbs (“giriş yap”, “seç”); sentence case; Turkish quotation marks “…”; typographic apostrophe ’ for suffixes on fixed names, never on inserted placeholders; plural nouns stay singular after numbers; decimal comma and %N percent form; names such as {name}/{title} follow a governing noun or a colon.
styles.uk: Неформальне звернення на «ти»; регістр речення; лапки «ялинки»; апостроф ’; вставлені назви лишаються в називному відмінку після іменника-керівника або двокрапки; кнопки — інфінітив/наказовий спосіб (Скасувати, Зберегти).
styles.zh-Hans: 简体中文（中国大陆）：使用“你”（不用“您”），简洁的界面用语；全角标点（，。：？“”），中文与英文/数字之间留一个空格，中文字之间不留空格；沿用 TIDAL 与主流音乐应用的称呼（播放列表、收藏、设置）；TIDAL、AutoMix、ReplayGain 等品牌名与 Max/High/Low 保持英文。
styles.zh-Hant: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan): 你 for address, Taiwan UI vocabulary (播放清單, 設定, 音訊, 待播清單), full-width punctuation with 「」 quotes, no spaces between Chinese characters, 位元完美 for bit-perfect, 獨佔模式 for exclusive mode.
